boundaries.colocated: One authority process plus all receivers in the coordinator process/event loop.
boundaries.isolated: One authority process, one coordinator process, and one receiver process per client.
boundaries.networkBytes: Exact UTF-8 application bytes accepted by authority ws.send callbacks; excludes WebSocket, TCP/IP, TLS/WSS, WAN, compression, and retransmission overhead.
boundaries.authorityCpu: Cumulative authority process CPU divided by its exact recorded 20.755-20.979 second health-sample timestamp delta; includes health polling and test-only replication accounting.
boundaries.decision: Machine-local one-match attribution only; not a hosted fleet, concurrent-match, 10 Hz capacity, or 24/48/96-client forecast.
